snippet.title: Hound Riders - Teaser trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4087910/Hound_Riders/

Hound Riders is a tactical ammo-building roguelite about bullets, magic, and survival in the Scarlands: a post-apocalyptic wasteland where witchcraft, blood, dust, and rust intertwine.

Perform the best combos to trigger your sigil's magical powers, travel with your hound through a nonlinear map, climb through the affinity tree and learn to carve your bullets to add extra powers to them... while also headbanging to one of the best adaptive soundtracks out there (We think).
